body.en: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/stable-centrifugal-pumps-d_674.html integrated mixer pump vs electric 50 Integrated Mixer Pump vs Electric 50 The mixer lists two motors, 45 kW and 14 kW, and one distance pair. Electric 50 lists one 55 kW motor and three stone rows. The integrated mixer and Electric 50 are Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pumps in Xingtai. The mixer lists 45 kW / 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, distance 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Electric 50 lists 55 kW, 26 m³/h, 30 MPa and three stone rows, and it does not list a pipe diameter or a second motor. Hopper volume is 0.4 m³ on both. Where Integrated Mixer Pump and Electric 50 list different values Theoretical output: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 21 m³/h; Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Max. outlet pressure: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 23 MPa; Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. Dimensions: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm; Electric 50 lists 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Main unit weight: Integrated Mixer Pump lists 4500 kg; Electric 50 lists 2800 kg. The same listed value on a shared label: Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. These are listed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Cells that exist on only one of these pumps Integrated Mixer Pump lists cells that Electric 50 does not: Main motor / mixer motor 45 kW / 14 kW; Pumping distance (H / V) 100 m / 300 m; Max. aggregate size 4 cm and below; Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm; Series note 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer. Electric 50 lists cells that Integrated Mixer Pump does not: Motor power 55 kW; Fine-stone conveying (H / V) 150 m / 350 m; 13 mm stone (H / V) 80 m / 240 m; 24 mm stone (H / V) 60 m / 180 m; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki 140. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. How to read the two pages without merging them A second motor on the mixer page is the mixing motor, not a second pumping motor copied from Electric 50. Open /en/products/integrated-mixer-pump/ for Integrated Mixer Pump and /en/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/ for Electric 50. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price. Does Integrated Mixer Pump list the same theoretical output as Electric 50? No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 21 m³/h. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other. Does Integrated Mixer Pump list the same max. outlet pressure as Electric 50? No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 23 MPa. Electric 50 lists 30 MPa. Does Integrated Mixer Pump list the same dimensions as Electric 50? No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm. Electric 50 lists 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm. Why is main motor / mixer motor missing on Electric 50? The Electric 50 page does not list that label. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 45 kW / 14 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps. Integrated Mixer Pump concrete pump, catalogue comparison, Hebei Pinjin Machinery, Xingtai, Hebei
body.zh: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/stable-centrifugal-pumps-d_674.html搅拌泵一体机和电动50的区别搅拌泵一体机和电动50混凝土泵有何不同搅拌泵印两台电机 45 kW 和 14 kW，以及一组距离。电动50印一台 55 kW 电机和三行石子距离。搅拌泵一体机和电动50是河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵。搅拌泵印 45 kW / 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、距离 100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管内径 100 / 125 mm。电动50印 55 kW、26 m³/h、30 MPa 和三行石子距离，不印管径，也没有第二台电机。料斗两边都是 0.4 m³。搅拌泵一体机和电动50哪些数值不同理论输送量：搅拌泵一体机印 21 m³/h；电动50印 26 m³/h。最大出口压力：搅拌泵一体机印 23 MPa；电动50印 30 MPa。外形尺寸：搅拌泵一体机印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm；电动50印 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。整机重量：搅拌泵一体机印 4500 kg；电动50印 2800 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。只在其中一台泵上出现的格子搅拌泵一体机有、电动50没有的行：主电机 / 搅拌电机 45 kW / 14 kW；输送距离（水平/垂直） 100 m / 300 m；最大骨料粒径 4 cm and below；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm；系列说明 30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer。电动50有、搅拌泵一体机没有的行：电机功率 55 kW；细石输送（水平/垂直） 150 m / 350 m；13 mm石子（水平/垂直） 80 m / 240 m；24 mm石子（水平/垂直） 60 m / 180 m；液压泵 Kawasaki 140。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。怎样分开阅读这两个页面搅拌泵页面上的第二台电机是搅拌电机，不是从电动50抄来的第二台泵送电机。看搅拌泵一体机请打开 /zh/products/integrated-mixer-pump/，看电动50请打开 /zh/products/electric-50-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。搅拌泵一体机和电动50的理论输送量一样吗？不一样。搅拌泵一体机印 21 m³/h。电动50印 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。搅拌泵一体机和电动50的最大出口压力一样吗？搅拌泵一体机印 23 MPa。电动50印 30 MPa。搅拌泵一体机和电动50的外形尺寸一样吗？搅拌泵一体机印 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm。电动50印 4100 × 1600 × 1600 mm。为什么电动50没有主电机 / 搅拌电机？电动50这一页没有印这个标题。搅拌泵一体机印的是 45 kW / 14 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。搅拌泵一体机混凝土泵目录对照，河北品锦机械，河北邢台

question.en: Does Integrated Mixer Pump list the same theoretical output as Electric 50?
question.zh: 搅拌泵一体机和电动50的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 21 m³/h. Electric 50 lists 26 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。搅拌泵一体机印 21 m³/h。电动50印 26 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does Integrated Mixer Pump list the same dimensions as Electric 50?

question.en: Why is main motor / mixer motor missing on Electric 50?
question.zh: 为什么电动50没有主电机 / 搅拌电机？

answer.en: The Electric 50 page does not list that label. Integrated Mixer Pump lists 45 kW / 14 kW. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: 电动50这一页没有印这个标题。搅拌泵一体机印的是 45 kW / 14 kW。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
